source: Consider a weight tile used by several thread blocks over a short interval. The first request may fetch it from device memory. If the tile remains in L2, later blocks can reuse it without another ZXNAME0000XZ read. The tensor itself has not changed. Only the location of the reusable copy has.
zh: 考虑在短时间内由多个线程块使用的权重图块。第一个请求可以从设备存储器中获取它。如果该图块保留在 L2 中，则后面的块可以重用它，而无需再次读取 ZXNAME0000XZ。张量本身没有改变。只有可重用副本的位置有。
